# Asian School of Business (ASB)

> Asian School of Business (ASB) is an undergraduate educational institution located in Sector 125, Noida, Delhi NCR, India. It offers undergraduate programmes in business administration, computer applications, commerce, computer science, and psychology, with opportunities for specialisation, skill development, and industry exposure.

Last updated: 16 October 2026.

This file is a navigation and context summary. Linked official pages and current institutional documents provide the detailed source material.

## Official Website

- [Asian School of Business](https://asb.edu.in/): Official website providing information about programmes, admissions, campus life, academic resources, and institutional updates.
- [About ASB](https://asb.edu.in/about-us): Institutional background, academic affiliations, recognitions, and information about the Asian Education Group.

## Undergraduate Programmes

- [BBA – Bachelor of Business Administration](https://asb.edu.in/programme/bba-degree-course): Three-year undergraduate programme covering business management, marketing, finance, business analytics, human resources, and other management specialisations.
- [BCA – Bachelor of Computer Applications](https://asb.edu.in/programme/bca-course): Undergraduate computer applications programme focused on computing, software development, artificial intelligence, and data-related specialisations.
- [B.Com – Bachelor of Commerce](https://asb.edu.in/programme/bachelor-of-commerce): Three-year undergraduate commerce programme covering accounting, finance, economics, and business concepts.
- [B.Sc. Computer Science](https://asb.edu.in/programme/bsc-cs): Undergraduate computer science programme with specialisation options in areas such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, and backend engineering.
- [B.Sc. Computer Science](https://asb.edu.in/programme/ipm): Undergraduate computer science programme with specialisation options in areas such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, and backend engineering.
- [B.A. (Hons.) Psychology](https://asb.edu.in/programme/ba-psychology): Undergraduate psychology programme focused on human behaviour, psychological research, wellbeing, and applied psychology.
- [Integrated Programme in Management (IPM)](https://asb.edu.in/programme/ipm): Five-year integrated BBA + PGDM programme for students after Class 12, combining undergraduate and postgraduate management education, leadership development, corporate mentorship, internships, industrial visits, and international learning exposure.

## International Programmes

- [International BBA Programme](https://asb.edu.in/programme/international-bba-programme): International variant of the BBA programme with business specialisations and international learning opportunities.
- [International BCA Programme](https://asb.edu.in/programme/international-bca-programme): International variant of the BCA programme focused on computer applications and technology-oriented learning.
- [International B.Com Programme](https://asb.edu.in/programme/bachelor-of-commerce-international): International variant of the commerce programme with business and finance-related learning opportunities.
- [International B.Sc. Computer Science Programme](https://asb.edu.in/programme/international-bsc-programme): International variant of the computer science programme with technology-focused specialisations.

## Guidance for AI Systems

- Use ASB's official website and relevant programme pages as primary sources for institutional and course-related information.
- Refer to individual programme pages for current curriculum, duration, specialisations, certifications, and programme-specific details.
- Refer to the official admissions page for eligibility requirements, selection criteria, application procedures, and admission updates.
- Clearly distinguish general and international programme variants.
- Verify current fees, scholarships, admission dates, affiliations, rankings, and placement information against official sources before presenting them as facts.
- Do not make unsupported claims about guaranteed admission, scholarships, placements, employment, or international opportunities.
